mainEntity.name: How do I find a bookkeeper near me?

acceptedAnswer.text: Enter your postcode and needs in our questionnaire. We match you with a registered bookkeeper who uses your software and knows your industry. The matching is free with no obligation.

mainEntity.name: Can a bookkeeper near me lodge my BAS?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — a registered BAS Agent can prepare and lodge your Business Activity Statement. All matched bookkeepers providing BAS services in our network have verified, current TPB registration.

mainEntity.name: Will the bookkeeper use the software I already have?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We match you with a bookkeeper experienced in your existing platform — Xero, QuickBooks Online, MYOB, Reckon or others. No migration is forced. If you want to switch, the matched bookkeeper can help, but it is never required.

mainEntity.name: What if I'm months behind on my books?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tell us in the questionnaire that you need catch-up bookkeeping. We connect you with a bookkeeper who specialises in bringing overdue books current — even multiple years behind.

mainEntity.name: How much does a local bookkeeper cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most small businesses spend $400–$1,200 per month for ongoing bookkeeping, though catch-up work or payroll-heavy businesses can be more. BAS-only engagements are usually $250-$400 per quarter. The matched bookkeeper gives you a clear quote after reviewing your needs — the matching is free.

mainEntity.name: Can a bookkeeper also handle my payroll and STP2?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Many bookkeepers in our network process payroll and manage Single Touch Payroll (STP2) reporting. Tell us in the questionnaire that you need payroll support and we will match you with a bookkeeper who offers that service.

mainEntity.name: How quickly will a matched bookkeeper contact me?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most matches are completed within 60 seconds of finishing the questionnaire. Your matched bookkeeper will typically reach out within 2 hours, or you can call for immediate assistance to discuss your needs.

mainEntity.name: Can I switch bookkeepers if the match isn't right?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You are under no obligation to proceed with any matched bookkeeper. If the first match isn't the right fit, let us know and we will connect you with another vetted local bookkeeper whose services and software experience better align with your needs.
